program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((cmd (at g 0 0))
         (rs (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 8)) (range 1 (rows g))))
         (cs (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g 0 c) 8)) (range 1 (cols g))))
         (sub (if (or (empty? rs) (empty? cs))
                  (list (list 0))
                  (for/list ([r (in-list rs)])
                    (for/list ([c (in-list cs)]) (at g r c))))))
    (cond [(= cmd 1) sub]
          [(= cmd 2) (rotate-cw sub)]
          [(= cmd 3) (rotate-180 sub)]
          [else (rotate-ccw sub)])))
